author: ThioJoe
description:
Game companies finally see how to make a game women like

After years of AAA game companies and major game studios making "puzzling" decisions all in the name of trying to attract a "broader audience" (and failing), there's a brand new game that puts them all to shame in the funniest way possible. It's called Dressmaker, and is literally a game about making dresses. And it's an instant success with overwhelmingly positive feedback and and hype for women gamers. Turns out all you had to do was make games your audience actually finds interesting all along!
